description: Ministry of Plantation - Sri Lanka Tea Board Law No. 14 of 1975
reasoning: This gazette contains regulatory matters - it rescinds existing regulations (Sri Lanka Tea Board Regulations No. 1 of 2010) and varies a cess (tax/levy) on tea under the Sri Lanka Tea Board Law. While it mentions individuals (Jayampathy Molligoda and Ramesh Pathirana), it does so in the context of their regulatory authority rather than detailing their personal appointments or portfolio responsibilities. The content primarily focuses on legal/regulatory changes to tea industry regulations and taxation.
